SIKASWELL® A: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaSwell® A, April 2023, Version 04.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikaswell_a.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaSwell® A where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaSwell® A is an acrylic sealing profile which swells in contact with water to seal all types of joints and penetrations in concrete. It has a rectangular profile and is available in several sizes.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - To seal.
    - Construction joints
    - Pipe and steel work penetrations through walls and floor slabs
    - Construction joints in cable ducts, etc.
    - Around all types of penetrations through concrete
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaSwell® A
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Acrylic swellable joint sealing profile
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Functional test to check sealing capacity,WISSBAU, Report No.2012-206
    - Agrément Certificate, Sika Hydrophilic Waterstops,BBA, Certificate No.13-4994
    - Test Report, Water tightness testing of hydrophilic waterstop, Vattenfall,Report No.1278-10
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Easy to apply
    - Can be applied on different substrates
    - Highly economical
    - Swells in contact with water
    - Can swell into cracks and gaps
    - Long-term reliability tested
    - Resistant against water and various chemical substances
    - No hardening time required
    - No welding required
    - Adaptable to fit many different detailing tasks
    - Different types and dimensions available
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Acrylic polymer
    - Appearance and colour: Rectangular red profiles. Swelled and unswelled profiles shown in image below.
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Swelling pressure: ≤ 16 bars after 3 days stored in tap water
    - Service temperature: 0 °C min. / +50 °C max.
2.6 Dimensions.
    | Type | Width | Height |
    | SikaSwell® A 2005 | 20 mm | 5 mm |
    | SikaSwell® A 2010 | 20 mm | 10 mm |
    | SikaSwell® A 2015 | 20 mm | 15 mm |
    | SikaSwell® A 2025 | 20 mm | 25 mm |
2.7 Swelling.
    | Time | Demineralised water | 5 % saline solution |
    | 3 days | ~100 % | ~60 % |
    | 7 days | ~150 % | ~100 % |
    | 14 days | ~200 % | ~120 % |
    | 21 days | ~220 % | ~140 % |
2.8 System structure. The following system products must be used:
    - SikaSwell® A
    - SikaSwell® S-2 Sealant
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 36 months from the date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.
2.10 Packaging. Rolls packed in cardboard boxes
    | SikaSwell® A 2005 | Roll of 20 m |
    | Box with 1 or 6 rolls |
    | SikaSwell® A 2010 | Roll of 10 m |
    | Box with 1 or 6 rolls |
    | SikaSwell® A 2015 | Roll of 7 m |
    | Box with 1 or 8 rolls |
    | SikaSwell® A 2025 | Roll of 5 m |
    | Box with 6 rolls |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - The substrate must be sound, clean, dry or matt damp, free from all surface contaminants SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
    - Existing Concrete
    - All loose particles, release agents, laitance, paint, rust and other poorly adhering materials must be removed by suitable hand or mechanical preparation.
    - Freshly cast concrete
    - During concreting, compact well around SikaSwell® A profiles to provide a dense concrete without any honeycombing or voids.
    - Surfaces which are excessively rough can be susceptible to leaking. It is recommend to smoothen the freshly cast concrete with a batten where the sealing profile is to be placed.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - SikaSwell® S-2 Sealant application
    - Apply SikaSwell® S-2 in a narrow bed (size of triangular section ~5 mm) onto the prepared substrate. Extrude sufficient quantity to level the roughness of the substrate. Refer to the SikaSwell® S-2 Product Data Sheet SikaSwell® A application
    - Cut the SikaSwell® A-Profile to the required length. Press the SikaSwell® A-Profile into the freshly applied SikaSwell S-2 until a small quantity is extruded from both sides of the profile to achieve a full surface bond. The profiles must be placed within max. 30 minutes. Connections and corners must be butt jointed and fixed. Allow SikaSwell® S-2 to harden for 2–3 hours before placing concrete. Protect the SikaSwell® A profiles against water (e.g. rain) until the concrete is placed.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Ensure a full and continuous contact between the SikaSwell® A profiles and the substrate is achieved.
    - The SikaSwell® A profiles require a reinforced concrete / concrete cover of at least 8 cm.
    - SikaSwell® A profiles expand in contact with water. This does not occur immediately, but slowly after several hours. It is advisable not to leave SikaSwell® A profiles in the open air or exposed to rain water (max. 24 hours as long as water can drain away)
    - Do not use profiles for movement joints.
    - If the water level suddenly increases the watertightness of joints will only be achieved after SikaSwell® A profiles have swollen.
    - In a totally dry state, SikaSwell® A profiles shrink to their original dimensions then expands again in contact with water.
    - Above 2,5 bar water pressure it is recommended to install an additional back-up system such as SikaFuko®-System.
    - If profiles are to be fixed around small diameter pipes use additional mechanical fixing with tie wire or a sleeve.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Substrate moisture content. Dry or matt damp. Do not apply in construction joints when standing water is existing.
5.3 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. For installation below +5 °C ambient temperature, special measures are required in accordance with relevant national regulations and Sika guidelines
5.4 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. For installation below +5 °C substrate temperature, special measures are required in accordance with relevant national regulations and Sika guidelines
5.5 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - SikaSwell® A profiles expand in contact with water. This does not occur immediately, but slowly after several hours. It is advisable not to leave SikaSwell® A profiles in the open air or exposed to rain water (max. 24 hours as long as water can drain away)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaSwell® A, April 2023, Version 04.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikaswell_a.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Material Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
